lines.zh: 缓慢蠕动前行，触手摩擦地面声响起。
lines.en: Slowly crawls forward, making rubbing sounds with tentacles.

lines.zh: 腹部触手轻轻触碰地面，发出沙沙声。
lines.en: Abdominal tentacles lightly touch the ground, producing rustling sounds.

lines.zh: 身躯缓慢扭动，寻找新的食物。
lines.en: Body twists slowly, searching for new food.

lines.zh: 触手缓缓伸展，寻找猎物。
腹部发出轻微蠕动声，似乎在觅食。
lines.en: Abdomen makes subtle crawling sounds, as if hunting.

lines.zh: 触手轻轻拍打地面，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Tentacles gently tap the ground, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 缓慢地移动，触手摩擦着周围的泥土。
lines.en: Slowly moves, tentacles rubbing against the surrounding soil.

lines.zh: 腹部的触手触碰地面，发出轻微的声音。
lines.en: Abdominal tentacles touch the ground, making a soft sound.

lines.zh: 缓慢地向前爬行，触手摩擦地面。
lines.en: Slowly crawls forward, tentacles rubbing the ground.

lines.zh: 腹部触手摩擦地面，发出细微声音。
lines.en: Abdominal tentacles rub the ground, making soft sounds

lines.zh: 我用胳膊拖着自己，一寸寸挪。
lines.en: I drag myself on my arms, inch by inch.

lines.zh: 腐烂的指节抠着土，往前爬。
lines.en: Rotten knuckles dig at the soil as I crawl.

lines.zh: 静止不动，触手紧紧缠绕在一起。
触手轻轻摆动，享受微风。
lines.en: Tentacles gently sway, enjoying the breeze.

lines.zh: 腹部缓慢收缩，保持放松。
触手偶尔轻轻动弹，看起来很放松。
缓慢地舒展触手，似乎在休息。
lines.en: Slowly extends tentacles, seeming to rest.

lines.zh: 腹部触手轻轻拍打，享受当前环境。
lines.en: Abdominal tentacles gently tap, enjoying the surroundings.

lines.zh: 触手轻轻触碰，保持不动。
腹部轻轻蠕动，似乎在休息。
lines.en: Abdomen gently crawls, seeming to rest.

lines.zh: 触手轻轻摆动，腹部放松。
触手紧紧缠绕，腹部放松。
突然抬头，触手迅速向玩家移动。
lines.en: Suddenly lifts head, tentacles quickly moving towards the player.

lines.zh: 腹部触手转向玩家，触须伸展寻找。
lines.en: Abdominal tentacles turn towards the player, tentacles extending to search.

lines.zh: 触手迅速伸向玩家，准备攻击。
lines.en: Tentacles quickly extend towards the player, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 腹部触手紧绷，盯住玩家。
lines.en: Abdominal tentacles tense, focusing on the player.

lines.zh: 触手迅速转头，寻找玩家。
lines.en: Tentacles quickly turn, searching for the player.

lines.zh: 腹部触手迅速伸展，准备捕捉玩家。
lines.en: Abdominal tentacles quickly extend, ready to capture the player.

lines.zh: 腹部触手紧张地伸展，盯着玩家。
lines.en: Abdominal tentacles tense, extending to stare at the player.

lines.zh: 触手迅速转向，准备攻击玩家。
lines.en: Tentacles quickly turn, ready to attack the player.

lines.zh: 腹部触手紧绷，紧紧盯着玩家。
lines.en: Abdominal tentacles tense, tightly focused on the player.

lines.zh: 触手伸向玩家，准备攻击或捕捉。
lines.en: Tentacles extend towards the player, ready to attack or capture.

lines.zh: 别打我，我爬得比谁都慢。
lines.en: Do not hit me, nobody crawls slower.

lines.zh: 我的下半身没有知觉了。
lines.en: I cannot feel the lower half of my body.
I can't hold on much longer...

lines.zh: 我的膝盖磨烂了，还在爬。
lines.en: My knees are worn to nothing; still crawling.
Decaying flesh draws me, meat paste land!

lines.zh: 尝尝我的力量，腐烂之吻！
lines.en: Feel my power, the rotting kiss!

lines.zh: 你是我的美食，美味尸体！

lines.en: Crawl over you, make you my food!

lines.zh: 享受腐朽的恩赐，死亡的盛宴！
lines.en: Enjoy the decay, the feast of death!

lines.zh: 饥饿驱使我，腐肉是我的食物！
lines.en: Hunger drives me, decayed flesh is my food!

lines.zh: 腐烂的触手，美味的猎物！
腐臭的气息中寻找食物！

lines.en: Avoid me, or you'll be devoured!
Collide with me, you'll be torn!

lines.zh: 我趴着，你还是踩到了我。
lines.en: I lie flat, and you still step on me.

lines.zh: 碰撞带来痛苦，这是真理！

lines.en: Collision means pain, come back hurt!
Even a crawler wants a partner.

lines.zh: 死亡的伴侣，我们的结合！

lines.en: Even this rotting hide wants a mate.

lines.zh: 就算只剩上半身，也想有个伴。
lines.en: Even half a body wants company.

lines.zh: 你的肉将成为我的养分

lines.en: Living flesh smells better than rot.
I raise my head and fix on your ankles.

lines.zh: 没人管我，我就自己找吃的。
lines.en: Nobody tends me, so I find my own food.

lines.zh: 下半身烂了，嘴还好好的。
lines.en: My legs rotted; my mouth still works.

lines.zh: 我贴地爬过来，你听不见。
lines.en: I crawl low and you hear nothing.

lines.zh: 我绕到草丛后面，等你经过。
lines.en: I slip behind the brush and wait.

lines.zh: 你不看脚下，我就在脚下。
lines.en: Look down: I am at your feet.

lines.zh: 我把下巴撑在石头上，看你。
lines.en: I rest my chin on a stone and watch.

lines.zh: 流血的味道，让我爬得更快。
lines.en: The smell of blood makes me crawl faster.
I stretch an arm; you are within reach.

lines.zh: 别跑，我爬得比你走得稳。
lines.en: Don't run; I crawl steadier than you walk.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，你逃不出我的触手！
lines.en: Hisss, you can't escape my tentacles!

lines.zh: 你的肉太鲜美，无法抗拒！
lines.en: Your flesh is too delicious to resist!

lines.zh: 触手缠上你，慢慢享受吧！
lines.en: Wrap you in my tentacles and enjoy!

lines.zh: 咬紧你，慢慢消化你的肉！
lines.en: Clamp you tight and savor your flesh!
Devour you and taste your fear!

lines.zh: 你是我的美食，现在就吃！
我的触手比你想象的更长！
lines.en: My tentacles are longer than you think!
You are destined to be my dinner!
I bite your calf and don't let go.
My nails rake and skin peels back.

lines.zh: 断腿的伤，我再撕开一次。
lines.en: That leg wound of yours; I reopen it.
I lunge with only my upper body.

lines.zh: 你倒下时，我正好爬到你身上。
lines.en: You fall, and I crawl right onto you.

lines.zh: 咬一口，你就会像我一样。
lines.en: One bite and you end up like me.

lines.zh: 我这一套皮囊，还没烂透。
lines.en: This hide of mine has not rotted through yet.
Crawl out of the rotten soil!
In the rubbish heap, I stir.
A hand crawls out from under the rubble.

lines.zh: 我拖着空荡的裤管出现。
lines.en: I appear dragging empty trouser legs.
At the ruin's edge I lift my head.

lines.zh: 地上多了个蠕动的影子。
lines.en: One more writhing shadow on the ground.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤开始腐烂，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My skin is rotting! — and the fire makes it worse.

lines.zh: 箭头钉在肩上，我照样爬。
lines.en: The arrowhead is stuck in my shoulder; I crawl anyway.

lines.zh: 我拖着断腿，还在往前挪。
lines.en: Broken leg dragging, I still creep forward.

lines.zh: 往下掉的时候，我还在爬。
lines.en: Even as I fall, I keep crawling.
